    How to use this

    Read the question. Answer it out loud first, then open the card and compare. Mark it Got it or Review again. Your marks stay in this browser only. Run a Mock interview to drill a random set against the clock.

    For algorithm problems, solve it yourself first, on paper or in an editor, then open the card to check your idea, your code and your Big O.
